title.narrative: Swedish Initiative for Facilitating Trade in Africa (SWIFT) 2024-2028
Swedish Initiative for Facilitating Trade in Africa (SWIFT) 2024-2028

description.narrative: Insatsens övergripande mål är att underlätta regional handeln längs med Abidjan-Lagos korridoren; Berbera korridoren; samt LAPSSET korridoren. I detta avseende syftar insatsen till att effektivisera tullprocedurerna, förbättra handelsinfrastrukturen, kapacitetsutveckla relevanta aktörer, samt stärka harmoniseringen av den regionala handelspolitiken med det specifika målet att bidra till en ökad gränsöverskridande handel och fattigdomsminskning inom och runt de utvalda korridorerna.

SWIFT is a comprehensive regional programme designed to address critical trade facilitation challenges across three major African trade corridors: Abidjan-­Lagos, the Berbera corridor, and the LAPSSET. The overarching objective of the programme is to foster inclusive and sustainable economic growth by increasing international and regional trade along these corridors. In this regard, the programme aims to streamline Customs operations through simplifying, standardizing, and harmonizing procedures and information; improve trade inclusivity; improve trade infrastructure; and strengthen regional trade policy harmonization with the specific objective of contributing to increased cross-­border trade and poverty reduction across the target corridors.

The contribution's overall objective is to address critical trade facilitation challenges across four major African trade corridors: Abidjan-Lagos corridor, the Berbera corridor, the LAPSSET corridor and the Northern Corridor. In this regard, the programme aims to streamline customs operations through simplifying, standardising, and harmonising procedures, and information in order to improve trade inclusivity, improve trade infrastructure and strengthen regional trade policy harmonisation with a long-term objective of contributing to increased cross-border trade and poverty reduction across the target corridors.
